hints.title: Distinct Suffix Counts
hints.text: Precompute the number of distinct elements present in each suffix from index i + 1 to n - 1.

hints.title: Distinct Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Traverse from left to right, maintaining a set of distinct elements seen in prefix 0 through i.

hints.title: Difference Calculation
hints.text: For each index i, the difference is size of prefix set minus suffix count.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Distinct Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def distinctDifferenceArray(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        suffix_distinct = [0] * (n + 1)
        seen_suff = set()
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            seen_suff.add(nums[i])
            suffix_distinct[i] = len(seen_suff)
        ans = []
        seen_pref = set()
        for i in range(n):
            seen_pref.add(nums[i])
            ans.append(len(seen_pref) - suffix_distinct[i + 1])
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Two passes computing prefix and suffix distinct counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding sets for both prefix and suffix at every step takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for suffix distinct counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes suffix counts to evaluate each index in O(1).
